chapters.title: 1. Colom unseats Hyde-Smith in the Mississippi Senate — Is an election a verdict on a person, a party, or a moment? And what does representation mean when a state's identity and its votes suddenly seem to diverge?

2. Republicans turn on Commerce Secretary Lutnick as the Nvidia espionage scandal widens — Can commerce and security be pursued together, or does a nation's safety sometimes require giving up profit? And how much should a leader's private life count as public business?
3. Netflix keeps Russell Brand's stand-up special after his rape conviction — Can we separate the art from the artist? Does continuing to show a work honor freedom or excuse the one who made it?
4. More than 30 UK Christian leaders call for a treaty on AI killer robots — Can a machine ever bear moral responsibility for taking a life? What does it mean to keep a human in the loop of judgment?
